description.p: Rosemary is an experimental macOS compatibility layer and emulator. It runs Mach-O executables and application bundles, with incomplete application compatibility.
The application menu opens a terminal where you can run rosemary. From an existing terminal, use flatpak run io.github.microlift.Rosemary /path/to/application.

The sandbox can access files in your home directory. The sandbox has a private /tmp. External drives are not included; add them with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media io.github.microlift.Rosemary. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.microlift.Rosemary.
